name: buckets-app
description: Golf match-play scoring app for Buckets

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server
